          img "Traffic loads are distributed effectively across multiple servers, ensuring scalability and high performance."

          h2 "Failover and error handling"
          p "Detect origin failures in real time, respond to HTTP 5xx and 404 errors, timeouts, and connectivity loss, and reroute traffic to healthy servers without disrupting service. Set primary and backup roles to trigger only when necessary, and tune connection and byte-timeout settings to speed detection and recovery."
          img "Load balancing adds fault tolerance by protecting against server failures."

          img "Distributed architecture without single points of failure and no vendor lock-in."
